{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The National Guard and Reserves are a fully operational and battle-tested component of the Armed Forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many members of the National Guard and Reserves have heroically served for multiple deployments resulting in inadequate time between deployments, also known as dwell time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to maintain the manpower and equipment strength of the National Guard and Reserves.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensure members of the National Guard and Reserves receive the pay, benefits, and adequate training to continue their service and maintain mission readiness through Presidential leadership and Congressional budget support.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The historic and continuing role of citizen-soldiers is a proud tradition linking every community across America to the cause of freedom.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Affirmation of service members' legal right to return to their civilian jobs, whether in government or the private sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Urging of greater transition assistance to and from employers as service members return to the civilian world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Saluting of employers who hire Reserve and Guard members, especially younger ones facing high unemployment rates, as a smart and patriotic business decision.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The spiritual welfare of troops and retired service members should be a priority of national leadership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"With military suicides running at the rate of one a day, with post-service medical conditions, including addiction and mental illness, and with the financial stress and homelessness that is often related to these factors, there is an urgent need for the kind of counseling that faith-based institutions can best provide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for rights of conscience and religious freedom for military chaplains and people of faith.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Commander in Chief will protect religious independence of military chaplains and will not tolerate attempts to ban Bibles or religious symbols from military facilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to enforce and defend in court the Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA) in the Armed Forces as well as in the civilian world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Call upon the President, the Secretary of Defense, and base and unit commanders to ensure that troops and retired service members, wherever stationed, have the opportunity to vote in the November elections, and that their ballots will be returned in time to be properly counted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Troops and retired service members who fight for and defend freedom around the world must not be disenfranchised.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
